name: Pipeline overdue
description: A scheduled pipeline (calendar, finance, home, jobs, trader heartbeat, trading status sync) has missed its schedule: hours since last success exceed the schedule budget (latest run that should have finished + allowance) for 2 hourly samples. Email, birds and backup have their own detectors.
programText:
r = data('grokbot.pipeline.age_ratio', filter=filter('pipeline', 'calendar', 'finance', 'home', 'jobs', 'trader', 'ls_trading'))
detect(when(r >= 1, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Pipeline overdue')

rules.parameterizedBody: {{dimensions.pipeline}} is overdue ({{inputs.r.value}}x its schedule budget). See the Bot Ops dashboard runbook: calendar, finance, home, jobs, trader, and ls_trading each have a refresh step.
